extracted.name: Ultimate Spinach Dip
extracted.description: This is the ultimate spinach dip! It is made from fresh spinach leaves and spring onions. It may be served at once, but tastes best when chilled for an hour. Serve with slices of sourdough baguettes.
ingredient_lines: 1 bunch fresh spinach, stems removed, torn into small pieces
1 (8 ounce) can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1 (.4 ounce) packet dry vegetable soup mix
0.5 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, toss together spinach, green onion stalks, and water chestnuts. Mix in the sour cream, mayonnaise, dry vegetable soup mix and dry onion soup mix.
